meta.name: impeccable
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重塑并精修网站与应用界面，使其更美观易用。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让自己的网站或应用界面变得更好看、更易用。
copy.tagline_en: Polish your website or app interface to make it clearer and more delightful.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website or app interface needs to look more refined and easier to use.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以设计总监的标准处理界面任务:先加载项目设计上下文,再按你选的路径(规划、评审、打磨、改版、动效等)产出前端代码或改进建议,并在浏览器里迭代。
howto.when: 当你想新建或改进网站、落地页、App 界面等前端界面,或要求做设计评审、视觉调优、可用性审计等界面改进时触发;后端及非 UI 任务不适用。

say.text: 帮我把这个落地页做得更大胆一些
say.note: 会走 bolder 流程,推几个更出挑的视觉方向。

say.text: 给我们的设置页做一次 UX 评审
say.note: 会按 critique 思路给启发式评分和改动建议。

say.text: 这个应用界面太吵了,帮我收一收
say.note: 会走 quieter 流程,压低视觉噪音。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude treats UI work like a design director: it loads the project’s design context, then plans, builds, critiques, polishes or visually revises frontend code, and iterates in the browser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create or improve a frontend surface (websites, landing pages, app UI, components, forms), do a design or UX review, or ask for bolder/quieter visuals. Not for backend or non-UI tasks.

say_en.text: Make this landing page bolder and more lively
say_en.note: Runs the bolder flow and proposes stronger visuals.

say_en.text: Do a UX review of our settings screen
say_en.note: Gives heuristic-style scores and fixes like critique.

say_en.text: This app UI feels too loud; calm it down
say_en.note: Follows the quieter routine to reduce visual noise.
